desc: Ideation complete: Analyzed the problem, identified cases for $p=2$, $K=0$, small $K$, and large $K$ with $p>2$.
Read input and identify zero positions.
Handle case: No zeros ($K=0$). Compute $A^p \pmod p$.
Handle case: $p=2$. Replace zeros with 1 to form unique $B$, compute $B^2 \pmod 2$.
Handle case: $p>2$ and $K \le 20$. Iterate all $(p-1)^K$ matrices $B$, compute $B^p \pmod p$, sum them up.
Handle case: $p>2$ and $K > 20$. Compute $A'$ (zeros replaced by 0). Compute $(A')^p \pmod p$. Multiply by $(-1)^K \pmod p$.
